capabilities: play audio tracks and playlists from the sidebar
import individual files or whole folders as playlists
reorder tracks by drag and drop and rename tracks or playlists
control shuffle, repeat modes, and 0.5x-2.0x playback speed
search tracks in the active playlist
extras: The manifest carries an automated-review disclaimer: this plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README points to CHANGELOG.md for version history and GitHub issues for bug reports.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play music or audio tracks from within the app while working.
summary: Sidebar audio player that plays local audio files as playlists with shuffle, repeat, playback speed, and volume controls.
